transitions._note: A=convex side. Beam enters convex first, exits flat. EFL = R/(n-1) = 99.65 mm, BFL = 97.28 mm (Thorlabs spec 97.3 mm). R=51.5, d=3.6, n=1.5168.
B=flat side. Beam enters flat first, exits convex. BFL = EFL = 99.65 mm (H' at convex vertex for plano-convex flat-first).

notes.calibrationStatus: Paraxial thick-lens ABCD with consistent [y, theta] convention (geometric translation d=3.6mm). Same recipe as LA1540-B/LA1614-B; only R changes -> 51.5mm.
notes.thickLensDerivation: Convex-first M_cf = M_flat_out . M_translate . M_convex_in = [[1,0],[0,n]] . [[1,d],[0,1]] . [[1,0],[-(n-1)/(n*R),1/n]]. Flat-first M_fc = M_convex_out . M_translate . M_flat_in = [[1,0],[-(n-1)/R,n]] . [[1,d],[0,1]] . [[1,0],[0,1/n]]. n=1.5168, R=51.5mm, d=3.6mm.
notes.principalPlanes: EFL = R/(n-1) = 99.65 mm (nominal 100). BFL_convex_first = EFL*(1 - d(n-1)/(n*R)) = 97.28 mm (Thorlabs spec 97.3 mm). BFL_flat_first = EFL = 99.65 mm.
notes.spec: Thorlabs LA1509-B: f=100mm, 1-inch plano-convex, AR-B coating 650-1050nm, N-BK7 substrate, center thickness 3.6mm, edge thickness 2.0mm, R=51.5mm. https://www.thorlabs.com/item/LA1509-B
